newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fedex introduces Europe-wide fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Fedex introduces Europe-wide fuel surcharge.

text.p: Federal Express is introducing a fuel surcharge from December 1 for all traffic originating in Europe, a Federal Express spokesman said.
FedEx is the first integrator, or company which provides a door-to-door freight service, to introduce a fuel surcharge.
Ten U.S. cents per kilo or the local currency equivalent will be added as a surcharge to its air freight shipments from Europe.
On Friday Fedex said it would introduced a surcharge on traffic originating in Benelux countries.
The surcharge will not be applied to its "priority shipments" (express service), he added.
FedEx has written to forwarders to inform them of the charge, he stressed.
Shippers and forwarders will be disappointed, air freight industry sources said.
